'''2007 Georgia State Championship Brian Rippetoe DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Rippetoe]] at [[2007 Georgia State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' All Your Whip Belong to me
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
